episodes.synopsis: A former boxer and current drunkard named Danpei Tange meets a drifter named Joe Yabuki and sees potential in him. Tange offers to teach Joe how to box, but Joe isn't easily convinced.
episodes.title: Those are the Eyes of a Beast!

episodes.synopsis: Danpei is severely hurt after trying to protect Joe from the yakuza. Joe goes to visit the head of the yakuza group to try to get reparations for Danpei.
episodes.title: The Live in the Square Jungle

episodes.synopsis: Danpei works hard day and night to save up for Joe and his boxing gym. Meanwhile, Joe uses the slum kids to con some money out of people and he runs into a woman named Yoko Shiraki.
episodes.title: Face the Fangs of the Beast

episodes.synopsis: Joe holes up in an abandoned building after he gets caught lying to con people out of money.
episodes.title: Shed Tears for the Burning Fist!

episodes.synopsis: Tange sends Joe a letter to teach him boxing while he's at the police hospital waiting for his fate.
episodes.title: For the Sake of Tomorrow! Part 1

episodes.synopsis: Joe ends up in a juvenile classification home and is quickly put into his place after trying to be cocky against his fellow inmates and their boss Nishi.
episodes.title: Explode! Left Jab!

episodes.synopsis: Joe, Tange, and the kids show up to court to hear if Joe will be sent off to the juvenile training school.
episodes.title: Don`t Judge the Wolf!

episodes.synopsis: Joe and Nishi spend their first night at the Toko Special Juvenile Training School and are quickly put into their places.
episodes.title: Toko High Security Juvenile Prison

episodes.synopsis: Joe and Nishi are sent out with the rest of the inmates to do some farmwork. Later on, Nishi comes up with a plan to help Joe escape the island, but they meet a man named Toru Rikiishi.
episodes.title: His Name is Rikiishi Toru!

episodes.synopsis: Joe is completely out of it after getting punched by Rikiishi. However, later on, he had a huge surprise in store for everyone.
episodes.title: Scream of the Red Sunset!

episodes.synopsis: Joe continues to practice boxing while he's alone in solitary. Danpei and the kids try to find a way into the juvenile training school when they unexpectedly run into Yoko.
episodes.title: Burn at the Bottom of Hell!

episodes.synopsis: Joe tells Yoko why he treats her so badly. Rikiishi tries to interfere and Yoko proposes that they settle this in a boxing match. Tange finally gets to train Joe again in person.
episodes.title: Shout at the Burning Sun

episodes.synopsis: Joe and Rikiishi prepare for their upcoming match. After seeing just how powerful Joe's new punch is, Rikiishi devises a unique training method to counter it.
episodes.title: Stand in the Ring of Destiny

episodes.synopsis: Joe and Rikiishi finally have their first match. But for some reason, Danpei tells Joe to let Rikiishi keep knocking him down. Who will be the winner in the end?
episodes.title: Is it Time for the KO Gong Yet!?

episodes.synopsis: Moved by the fight between Joe and Rikiishi, the inmates also start boxing.
episodes.title: White Mat's Lullaby

episodes.synopsis: Tange becomes the full-time boxing coach at the juvenile training school on Nogiku Island. Joe seems to finally be interested in training more with Tange, but Tange suddenly seems distant.
episodes.title: The Setting Sun of Treachery

episodes.synopsis: Joe keeps trying to get Tange to coach him again, but Tange just keeps ignoring him and concentrates on training Aoyama. No one expected Aoyama to get into the tournament, but he then somehow defeats the rep for dorm 7, Numata.
episodes.title: Alone in the Middle of a Storm

episodes.synopsis: The dormitory boxing tournament begins and everyone finds out just how Aoyama defeated Numata.
episodes.title: Ring Ropes of Despair

episodes.synopsis: Joe and Aoyama's match finally begins, but who will come out on top?
episodes.title: The Fearsome Liver Blow

episodes.synopsis: Joe and Aoyama's match concludes and Tange reveals something to our two fighters.
episodes.title: Battle Scarred Victory

episodes.synopsis: Rikiishi tells Joe that they need to have their match sooner because something came up, so they have an unofficial match out in the rain.
episodes.title: A Small Fight with a Big Honor

episodes.synopsis: Rikiishi leaves Toko Special Juvenile Training School and Joe feels empty inside. Meanwhile, the final match of the dorm boxing tournament is about to begin.
episodes.title: The Legendary Rikiishi Tooru

episodes.synopsis: Following Rikiishi and Aoyama, Nishi is also going to leave the juvenile training school, leaving Joe all alone.
episodes.title: Farewell, Juvenile Prison

episodes.synopsis: Joe finally leaves the juvenile training school and goes back to the slums where he's welcomed back with open arms, and Danpei has a surprise for him.
episodes.title: Return to Slum Town

episodes.synopsis: Joe finally feels like something might be changing in his life, but then he is visited by Guerilla, who's on the run from the police.
episodes.title: Law of the Stray Dog

episodes.synopsis: Tange goes to the Japan Boxing Association to get his gym officially recognized. Meanwhile, Joe starts working at the grocery store Nishi works at.
episodes.title: License of Despair

episodes.synopsis: Tange is unable to get the license for his gym, but then, an unexpected visitor gives them an unbelievable offer.
episodes.title: Bridge to Tomorrow

episodes.synopsis: Joe goes to see the All Japan Rookie Championship Tournament and figures out a way to get one of the members of the Boxing Association to give Tange the license he needs for his gym.
episodes.title: Wager for Glory

episodes.synopsis: Tange is able to get the license for his gym after the stunt Joe pulled at the All Japan Rookie Championship Tournament, but he says that Joe's not ready to become a pro yet himself. However, Joe's got his own ideas.
episodes.title: Challenge for Tomorrow

episodes.synopsis: Joe and Nishi go take the pro boxing test and Joe finds out that it's not as easy as he thought it would be.
episodes.title: The Ordeal of the Pro Test

episodes.synopsis: Joe passes the B-rank exam and takes his first real step towards becoming a pro.
episodes.title: Spread Your Wings, Pro Boxer

episodes.synopsis: Nishi and Joe both have their debut matches in the pro ring.
episodes.title: The Road to the Shining Ring

episodes.synopsis: Everyone celebrates after Joe's first victory. Noriko gets him violets but those are quickly overshadowed by the giant bouquet of roses Yoko sends him.
episodes.title: Hooray for the First Victory

episodes.synopsis: Ishikura watches Joe win a boxing match and decides he wants to be just like him. He then suddenly shows up to Tange's gym wanting to join, but Tange surprisingly refuses.
episodes.title: The Aspiring Boxer

episodes.synopsis: Nishi loses all three matches so far after becoming a pro and loses his confidence. Tange, Joe, and the kids try to find a way to build his confidence back up and Kinoko finds a surprising solution.
episodes.title: Do Your Best! Nishi!

episodes.synopsis: Joe continues winning match after match and asks Tange when he's going to go up against Wolf Kanagushi. Tange tells him they're going to take it nice and slow, but then, Otaka sends them an invitation...
episodes.title: Wolf Kanagushi Bares His Fangs

episodes.synopsis: Joe, Tange, and Nishi are anxious about what Wolf's secret training could be. The kids decide they'll sneak into the Asia Boxing Club to find out what Wolf's training is, but things go terribly wrong.
episodes.title: Training Furiously

episodes.synopsis: Joe and Wolf's match finally begins. Whose training will bring them victory?
episodes.title: The Greatest Six-Round Bout in History

episodes.synopsis: Joe and Wolf's intense match finally comes to an end. Who will stand victorious?
episodes.title: The Triple Cross of Victory

episodes.synopsis: Tange takes Joe, Nishi, and the rest of the neighborhood on a hot springs trip to celebrate Joe's victory, but on their way up, they find out that Wolf may have been incapacitated.
episodes.title: An Oath to the Snow

episodes.synopsis: The new year has arrived and Joe finds out that Rikiishi is losing weight to become a bantamweight so he can face off with Joe.
episodes.title: Rikiishi Tooru`s Challenge

episodes.synopsis: Joe and Rikiishi continue training for their match. However, Rikiishi is starting to worry Yoko and Mikinosuke because he is going to extreme lengths to lose weight.
episodes.title: A Man`s World

episodes.synopsis: Tange formally accepts Shiraki Gym's match request between Rikiishi and Joe and he tells Joe about Rikiishi's brutal weight loss regimen. Meanwhile, Nishi doesn't seem to be losing any weight...
episodes.title: A Cruel Weight Loss

episodes.synopsis: Rikiishi has his first match as a bantamweight against Pancho Leo. Who will come out on top?
episodes.title: Rikiishi Tooru`s Hard Fight!

episodes.synopsis: Joe asks Tange and Nishi to help him improve his sway backs so he has a way to counter Rikiishi.
episodes.title: Sway Back to Defeat Rikiishi!

episodes.synopsis: While Joe continues his intense training, Rikishi is equally devoted to maintaining his weight.
episodes.title: The Man Who Risked Death

episodes.synopsis: On the day of the match, Joe and Danpei reunite with Rikishi during the weigh-in and acknowledge his impressive weight-cutting success.
episodes.title: The Two Before the Storm

episodes.synopsis: Joe realizes that Rikishi has stabilized his body after extreme weight loss.
episodes.title: Showdown of Destiny

episodes.synopsis: Rikishi's uppercut grazes Joe's cheek, causing it to bleed. Alarmed, Joe moves in close during the third round, leading to an intense exchange of hooks.
episodes.title: An Endless Deathmatch

episodes.synopsis: Joe fortifies his guard for the first time in his professional career, but Rikishi's fierce attack knocks him down.
episodes.title: End of the Battle

episodes.synopsis: The fierce battle ends. Joe extends a congratulatory handshake to Rikishi, who starts to smile but collapses onto the mat.
episodes.title: Burnt-out Life

episodes.synopsis: On the day of Rikishi's funeral, Joe leaves their condolences to Danpei and Nishi and tries to distract himself by playing energetically with the children by the riverside.
episodes.title: Farewell, Rikiishi Toru

episodes.synopsis: Joe wanders through the town on a snowy night, carrying memories of Rikishi. To Joe, who has no family, Rikishi was an irreplaceable presence...
episodes.title: The Man I Hate

episodes.synopsis: Three days after Joe disappeared, a ten-count gong was held at Korakuen Hall to mourn Rikishi's death. Joe watches the scene on a street-side TV.
episodes.title: The Ten-Count Bell of Sorrow

episodes.synopsis: Joe sees Wolf Kanagushi, who has become a bodyguard for the yakuza, on the streets.
episodes.title: The Wandering Ballad

episodes.synopsis: The brawl with Gondo is treated as extenuating circumstances. After being informed by reporters, Danpei quickly retrieves Joe.
episodes.title: The Wolf Revives

episodes.synopsis: Joe continues training and lands a powerful body blow during sparring with Nishi. However, Nishi notices that Joe avoids striking the head, arousing suspicion.
episodes.title: A Wounded Beast

episodes.synopsis: The ten-round match between Joe and Tonotani begins. Danpei and Nishi, concealing their concerns, watch over Joe.
episodes.title: The Body Blow of Victory

episodes.synopsis: Having returned to form, Joe defeats several Japanese bantamweight contenders with his fierce body attacks.
episodes.title: The Looming Black Shadow

episodes.synopsis: Pre-match predictions favor Tiger in his fight against Joe. Around this time, the head of Bokuto Gym invites Joe to spar with him, saying it is to substitute for Nishi, who injured his fist.
episodes.title: The Fierce Sparring

episodes.synopsis: In the fight against Tiger, Kunimoto, the Sun Gym president, claims to have uncovered Joe's weakness. In truth, Tiger realizes that Joe cannot properly strike the face.
episodes.title: The Thrown Towel

episodes.synopsis: After the fight, Danpei shockingly reveals the truth to Joe. However, learning that his actual opponent is the 'ghost of Rikishi' haunting him, Joe strengthens his resolve.
episodes.title: Rikiishi Toru was Alive

episodes.synopsis: The slump in Joe's performance casts a shadow over the slums. Even so, Joe continues his desperate battle against himself, repeatedly striking the sandbag's temple position.
episodes.title: The Final Challenge

episodes.synopsis: Carlos prays for both fighters' success in the ring for Joe's match against Nangou. As the fight begins, Joe faces his poor condition and a referee influenced by the Hyo clan.
episodes.title: Enter Carlos

episodes.synopsis: After Joe's devastating loss to Nangou, Danpei dissolves the Tange Gym. He entrusts the future of Joe and Nishi to the proprietor of Hachiya, but Joe resolves to continue boxing alone.
episodes.title: As Long as There's the Ring

episodes.synopsis: Joe departs from the Namidabashi Bridge early in the morning and meets a boy who dreams of traveling to far-off places on his way to Ueno Station. Joe sympathizes with his story.
episodes.title: Setting Out for Tomorrow

episodes.synopsis: A postcard arrives, informing the children of Joe's whereabouts in Oarai. Determined to meet him, they head to Ueno Station, but an attempt at fare-dodging is discovered, forcing them to disembark.
episodes.title: A Little Adventure

episodes.synopsis: Joe's new career in the traveling show begins. Kawano attempts to promote Joe as a star by arranging fixed matches and instructing the others to take deliberate losses.
episodes.title: Fixed Match

episodes.synopsis: On a day off, Joe goes hiking with Inaba and falls off a cliff in the fog. Yuri, the daughter of a nearby Hiyama Ranch, rescues him.
episodes.title: Lullaby of the Ranch

episodes.synopsis: Yoko organizes a Carlos vs. Nangou match in Sendai, where Joe performs. Interested in Joe, Carlos and Robert visit the Namidabashi Bridge and learn how much Joe is still loved by the community.
episodes.title: The Guy I'm Worried About

episodes.synopsis: Joe's performances continue at the sparsely attended Hakusan Shrine. During a break, Joe positions himself in front of the TV Kawano bought, intently watching Carlos's match against Nangou.
episodes.title: Carlos the Uncrowned Emperor

episodes.synopsis: A postcard from Noriko brings news about the Namidabashi community. However, since watching Carlos's fight, Joe has been unable to focus on his performance.
episodes.title: Return to the Shining Ring

episodes.synopsis: Returning to Tokyo, Joe visits Yoko and requests to spar with Carlos. Reluctantly, Yoko agrees and insists they use heavier 16-ounce gloves for safety.
episodes.title: The Cross Counter Returns

episodes.synopsis: Tange Gym fell into disrepair during Joe's absence. Joe begins rebuilding it with Danpei and the children.
episodes.title: Setting Out Today

episodes.synopsis: As Joe resumes training in the Namidabashi slums, Noriko watches with a complex expression. Meanwhile, the day of Carlos's match against Harashima arrives.
episodes.title: Carlos, Magician of the Ring

episodes.synopsis: Yoko finalizes the contract for a Carlos vs. Tiger match. Carlos confidently declares he will win with a first-minute KO.
episodes.title: The Burning Challenge

episodes.synopsis: Robert's old friend, promoter Henry James, arrives in Japan. Henry arranges a match between Carlos and the world champion, Jose Mendoza, and proposes canceling the fight with Joe.
episodes.title: Battle of Men

episodes.synopsis: The day of Carlos's match against Tiger arrives. As a boxing fan, Danpei expresses his feelings about Joe's journey. Yoko quietly encourages Joe as they pass in the hallway.
episodes.title: Duel!! Carlos Vs. Yabuki Joe

episodes.synopsis: Carlos counters Joe's rope-side techniques with an improvised move, nullifying Joe's strategy. He then proposes an all-out brawl with no tricks.
episodes.title: Let the Shining Tomorrow Burn in the Distance!!
